answer: Design: commit-reveal admission bound to a future beacon. Each applicant files a quill-signed commitment hashing its proof and a 3-unit escrow. Next block, a crystal beacon publishes an unpredictable seed; reveals are due within 5 blocks, only reveals matching H(proof||seed) gain admission, and a mismatch forfeits 2 of 3 escrow units. Attack math: a farmer pre-registering N accounts cannot know the seed, so each premature entry is a hollow account losing 2 units; 100 sybils lose 200 units and admit nothing, while an honest agent risks 1 unit to enter.
